packageRules.description: release/v3.7 is only consumed by rancher release/v2.15
release/v3.3 is shared by rancher release/v2.12 and release/v2.13; use the oldest/tightest of the two ceilings
release/v3.6 is only consumed by rancher release/v2.14
release/v2 predates every per-release-line preset and has no active consumer; keep it fully disabled for k8s.io/sigs.k8s.io rather than adopting a ceiling that doesn't apply to it
Disable major updates on release branches
Do not bump golang.org/x/* minor/major on release branches - unnecessary churn on stable branches; x/tools specifically can force a go directive minor bump
Do not bump the Go minor/major version on release branches
Pin Go minor on main to the Go version of the highest supported k8s (k8s 0.37 -> go 1.26); patch bumps still allowed
Pin Go minor on main to the Go version of the highest supported k8s (k8s 0.37 -> go 1.26); patch bumps still allowed (BCI image tags use docker versioning, so match by regex)

Pin Go minor on release/v3.6 to the Go version of the highest supported k8s (k8s 0.35 -> go 1.25); patch bumps still allowed (BCI image tags use docker versioning, so match by regex)
Pin Go minor on release/v3.3 to the Go version of the highest supported k8s (k8s 0.34 -> go 1.24); patch bumps still allowed
Pin Go minor on release/v3.3 to the Go version of the highest supported k8s (k8s 0.34 -> go 1.24); patch bumps still allowed (BCI image tags use docker versioning, so match by regex)
Do not update the rancher/renovate-config digest on release branches - only main's renovate.json is ever used, so keeping release branch copies in sync is unnecessary
Group all GitHub Actions updates into a single PR per branch
Group Go dev tooling (Go version, golangci-lint) into a single PR per branch
Group golang.org/x/* packages into a single PR per branch
Group SUSE BCI base image updates into a single PR per branch
